# er605_qos_rule (Resource)

Transmission > QoS > bandwidth control rule. Rules go last. QoS must have been saved once (er605_qos) before the router accepts rules.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `if_ping` (String) source interface, e.g. LAN
- `if_pong` (String) WAN, e.g. WAN1 or WAN_ALL
- `mode` (String) share or priv
- `name` (String)
- `rate_max` (Number) kbps
- `rate_max_mate` (Number) kbps
- `source_type` (String) network or ip_group
- `time` (String)

### Optional

- `comment` (String)
- `enable` (Boolean)
- `ip_group` (String)
- `network` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
